title: Legacy Certification Runtime and Feature Parity

preflight.note: Registered before implementation in a clean isolated public worktree at exact base 927a57c9119d24581e8fe3fc1f1bd68e7ab1d0af after verifying WI324-WI329 were free. The shared dirty checkout, WI323 worktree, private repository, installed application, and preserved learner backup are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Legacy certification courses are represented or adapted to the canonical package/runtime contract so supported learner features behave consistently across course sources.
Legacy learner progress conversion into the canonical envelope is deterministic, identity-safe, recoverable, and preserves apex-state and backup compatibility until verified migration succeeds.

Feature-parity coverage includes instruction, assessment, remediation, capstone where authored, lecture, Academic Record, instructor, and lab capabilities as supported by each course, without fabricating authored content or results.
Public-safe migration and parity tests prove old state remains recoverable and all converted state maps to the intended course identity and namespace.

source: Accepted persistence/state-authority discovery and user direction that the course-platform learner envelope is canonical; actual legacy conversion is deferred from WI324.
